summary: First full-pass testing of Kedar Chashtve growth portfolio (backend + frontend). All 5 backend API tests pass (case studies list/sort/fields, slug fetch with +47% metric, 404 on unknown, status POST+GET round-trip). All 41 frontend behavior checks pass (hero headline/subhead/CTAs, 4 animated metric counters reaching 4+/20+/47%/5x, animated dashboard visible at lg, case study modal opens with Problem/Strategy/Actions/Results/Tools, 5 framework nodes with hover-expand bullets, 3 timeline roles + earlier-roles toggle, 4 skill clusters with hover example reveal, 5 Currently Exploring cards, contact email/LinkedIn/resume buttons hit exact expected URLs, NO GitHub link anywhere in DOM, nav links scroll to anchors).

issues: A11y console warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent'. Low priority – add a <DialogDescription> or aria-describedby for screen-reader users.

action_items: (Nice-to-have / a11y) Add DialogDescription inside CaseStudies modal to silence Radix aria-describedby warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses @app.on_event('startup') (deprecated in newer FastAPI) – consider migrating to lifespan handlers for future-proofing. Not breaking right now.
Seed is destructive on every boot (delete_many + insert_many). Acceptable here because case studies are 100% static config, but if any user-editable fields are added later this would wipe them.

logger is referenced inside seed_data() but logging.basicConfig + logger = getLogger() are declared AFTER the @app.on_event('startup') decorator. Works because seed runs at startup (after module import completes), but moving logger init above the decorator would be cleaner.
GET /api/case-studies and /status correctly exclude _id projection – no ObjectId leakage observed.
Frontend uses process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL everywhere with /api prefix – compliant with routing rules.
All interactive elements have data-testid – very testable codebase.
seed_data_creation: Backend auto-seeds 3 case studies on startup (idempotent). Added 1 TEST_portfolio_qa status check via API test (not destructive).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test suite at /app/backend/tests/test_portfolio_api.py covers case-studies list/slug/404 and status POST/GET. Frontend tested via Playwright on the preview URL covering hero counters, dashboard, case-study modal, framework hover, experience timeline + earlier roles toggle, 4 skill clusters + hover examples, 5 exploring cards, contact buttons (email/linkedin/resume), and absence of GitHub. Nav anchor scrolling: viewport-bounds assertion for tall sections (#case-studies) can read as 'out of view' even when content is rendered – use a relaxed bound (e.g., r.bottom > 0 AND r.top < window.innerHeight) if re-testing.
